name: KATY HOWARTH | COLOUR, BLACKWORK, FUN TATTOOS | BRISTOL
bio:
Katy Howarth is a masterful tattoo artist known for her exceptional work in illustrative and traditional styles, with a special emphasis on neo-traditional and botanical designs. Her dedication to maintaining a spotless and hygienic workspace at Tattootime on 88 North Street, Bristol, reflects not only her professionalism but also her commitment to the cleanliness essential in the art of tattooing. Clients appreciate her meticulous attention to sterilization and her methodical approach, ensuring a safe, comfortable tattooing experience every time.
